create.name: Steve Taylor
create.bio:
Steve Taylor is a psychologist, author and poet who lives in Manchester and lectures in psychology at Leeds Beckett University. His research is about spiritual awakening: what happens when a person shifts into a calmer, more connected way of being, sometimes slowly through practice and sometimes suddenly after a crisis. He once led the British Psychological Society's transpersonal psychology section, writes regularly for general readers, and his books have been translated into more than twenty languages, two of them published in Eckhart Tolle's own imprint.

His best-known titles include Waking From Sleep, The Fall, The Leap, Spiritual Science and The Adventure, a practical handbook that pairs short teachings with guided meditations and exercises. He also writes brief contemplative poems, gathered in The Calm Center and The Clear Light. Beyond his university teaching, which includes modules on contemporary spirituality, he leads an eight-week online course on Zoom built around presence, gratitude, acceptance and loosening the grip of the ego, and he gives talks at festivals and bookshops around the UK. With Serge Beddington-Behrens he hosts Fierce Grace, a series of video conversations on spirituality and human development on his YouTube channel.

books.title: The Leap: The Psychology of Spiritual Awakening
books.author: Steve Taylor
books.description: A study of people who have shifted, gradually or suddenly, into a lasting awakened state. Drawing on interviews and on spiritual traditions, it describes what changes in perception and identity and why it happens.

books.title: Waking From Sleep: The Causes of Awakening Experiences and How to Make Them Permanent
books.author: Steve Taylor
books.description: An early book that looks at moments of heightened awareness, what tends to bring them about, from meditation to nature, and how such glimpses might become a steady way of living.

books.title: The Fall
books.author: Steve Taylor
books.description: A wide historical argument that a change in human consciousness several thousand years ago brought a strong sense of separate ego, with war and inequality following, and that our task now is to move beyond it.

books.title: Spiritual Science: Why Science Needs Spirituality to Make Sense of the World
books.author: Steve Taylor
books.description: A case against strict materialism. He sets out a view he calls panspiritism, in which a fundamental spiritual quality runs through all things, and tests it against questions science struggles with.

books.title: The Adventure: A Practical Guide to Spiritual Awakening
books.author: Steve Taylor
books.description: A hands-on companion to his research, mixing short teachings with guided meditations, exercises, stories and poems for readers who want to work with awakening day to day.

books.title: The Calm Center: Reflections and Meditations for Spiritual Awakening
books.author: Steve Taylor
books.description: A collection of short poetic pieces meant to be read slowly, each one pointing back to stillness and present-moment awareness.

books.title: The Clear Light: Spiritual Reflections and Meditations
books.author: Steve Taylor
books.description: A second book of contemplative poems in the same spirit as The Calm Center, written as small meditations on presence, connection and wonder.

books.title: DisConnected: The Roots of Human Cruelty and How Connection Can Heal the World
books.author: Steve Taylor
books.description: A look at human behaviour through the lens of connection. He argues that cruelty grows from a sense of separation, and that altruism and spirituality are expressions of our basic interconnection.

courses.title: The Adventure Online Course
courses.description: An eight-week course on Zoom, one Sunday evening session a week, each taking one theme of awakening such as presence, gratitude, acceptance or stepping back from the ego. Sessions combine meditation, poetry and discussion, and recordings, guided meditations and a course forum are included.

free_resources.title: Poetic Meditations & Reflections
free_resources.description: His own short spiritual poems, free to read on his site. Each is written to be read slowly as a small meditation on presence and connection.

free_resources.title: Essays and Articles
free_resources.description: A free archive of his essays, from pieces for general magazines to academic papers, on awakening experiences, time, death and the roots of human conflict.
